honest_c3: C1 — mac CPU fp32, no GPU, single-process. Realistic SFT requires 1B+ tokens dialogue corpus + multi-epoch + GPU; this is a 5-example 1-epoch micro smoke testing whether the retrofit *channel* is viable, not whether the *trained model* is chat-capable.

C2 — body BPE 64K input vs lm_head 256 byte-vocab is a deliberate MISMATCH BY DESIGN (retrofit hypothesis): we test whether the BPE-encoded body's ln_f hidden state contains enough signal to drive a byte-vocab head AT ALL. Proper retrofit requires either (a) re-tokenize body input at byte-level (cheap; body sees raw bytes), or (b) train a BPE→byte adapter layer between ln_f and lm_head_byte.

C3 — last-token-only loss is severely impoverished: only the FINAL byte of each dialogue is supervised, not the full sequence. Proper byte-level SFT supervises every byte position with byte-level shift_labels. This micro test essentially asks: 'can byte_head memorize 5 final-byte targets'. Better signal needs T_byte-aligned supervision (requires body to produce byte-aligned hidden positions).

C4 — body is frozen but BPE tokenization fragments Korean characters into multi-byte BPE pieces; the ln_f hidden at the LAST BPE position encodes 'next BPE token', not 'next UTF-8 byte'. Byte-head decode operates on a token-level hidden but predicts byte units — there is a granularity gap that even perfect SFT cannot bridge without re-tokenizing body input. This explains why even PASS here would still indicate channel-viable, not production-ready.

C5 — BG-DS HEAD-bound + BG-DC direction problem path informs this design. BG-DS showed CLM-L15-hidden → KoGPT2-head produces 58 Korean chars; that retrofit kept BPE-style head (subword units). Here we test the harder case: BPE body → BYTE head. If F-BYTE-RETROFIT-1 FAIL_MICRO with improvement≤0, channel is too narrow under naive retrofit. Full implementation = body byte-tokenizer rewire + 1B-token corpus + multi-epoch SFT (separate cycle, ~$100-500 GPU).

C6 — Option γ FULL implementation roadmap (architectural fix path): (a) replace tok_emb 64000→256 byte-level, requires 256×768 = 196K param init from scratch; (b) replace head_a 64000→256, weight-tied to new tok_emb; (c) train on 100M+ Korean dialogue tokens (mc4-ko + KoChat + AI Hub dialogue corpora); (d) preserve 16-layer body weights via tok_emb→768 projection if needed. Estimated $200-1000 H100 spend for chat-capable byte-level CLM v4.5. anima-native (no Llama, no KoGPT2) but requires architectural commitment.

option_gamma_full_implementation_estimat.training_corpus: 100M+ Korean dialogue tokens (mc4-ko + KoChat + AI Hub)
option_gamma_full_implementation_estimat.anima_nativity: preserved (CLM body weights retained, vocab swap only)
